description: A fun list of things you can be judged for by the townsfolk near the end of the game: _Loner's Landing_ - Ignoring the captain after waking up from the shipwreck _Southern Outskirts_ - Danced with [Grinnsly](https://mapgenie.io/mina-the-hollower/maps/tenebrous-isle?locationIds=593515) _Ossex_ -
